metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: HIXCEA crystallizes in the trigonal crystal system with space group P -3. Reported CIF formula moiety: C36 H56 Ce6 F36 O50 S12 2-,2(C15 H34 N1 O6 1+). From the CIF bond table, Ce1 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce2 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce4 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce5 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce6 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce7 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce3 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce8 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce9 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce11 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce13 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce15 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce3B (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce10 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce12 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce14 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce16 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce18 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 66 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 0.223-4.280 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 2.45-117.23°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [H2]2[Ce6(OH)8(OTf)12(THF)6] (C36H56Ce6F36O50S12)2-·2(C15H34NO6)+. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 8 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
